caveats: Connectivity only: river reaches potentially downstream of the outfall on the mapped network. Not a measurement or model of pollution, concentration, dilution, travel time, exposure or water safety.
Generalised network: Ordnance Survey generalisation omits many headwater streams, so outfalls on unmapped streams cannot be linked to a reach.
Dendritic simplification: canals, drains and braided or secondary channels that broke the tree structure were deleted, so canal outfalls are not represented and distributaries are not traced.
The network derives from the February 2023 OS Open Rivers release; ORN has no scheduled updates.
Catchments are derived from the 50 m OS Terrain 50 DEM with stream burning and exist only where they passed the source's quality control.

summary.mainStem: River Trent <- Head of Trent <- source

catchment.note: Source DEM catchment of the nearest published sample at or downstream of the start; it may include up to pourPointOffsetM of extra river. Area is from the full-resolution source; the polygon may be simplified.
